items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions Benny Goodman as 'the King of Swing' and references 'Benny Goodman's band' and 'Allan Reuss... was with Benny Goodman', but does not state a personal interaction, collaboration, or direct acquaintance with Goodman himself.

ctx.x: When Benny Goodman came. They needed a title for him. Paul Whiteman was called the King of Jazz. Here comes Benny Goodman. They name him the King of Swing. And . . . what’s his name . . . Presley, the King of Rock.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He's the first one that told me about Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: He's the first one that told me about Benny Goodman. He said, "Man..."
